answer: Growth punishes the attacker, not the network: the opal per clone stays flat while the bill climbs, and the kernel is the point where cloning stops paying. Make the first reward the most expensive one to reach. Confirmed harbour pilot licence with harbour pilots authority confirmation does that, because a licence the authority renews after pilotage audits. The beacon for a single honest agent is a short check; for a farm it is fourteen days of calendar wait per proof, so a hundred clones need nearly four years of queue time between them repeated on every name.
